tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Look up a deployed token by contract/mint address and report whether it impersonates a real company, its "official" token or its tokenized stock (e.g. a fake SpaceX, Coinbase or NVDAx coin). Returns verdict (likely_impersonation | brand_mention_watch | not_in_index), matched brands, risk score 0-100

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Run the impersonation detector on a token name and/or ticker symbol without needing an address. Tells you whether a coin called e.g. "SpaceX Official" ($SPACEX) or "TSLAx" would be flagged as impersonating a brand, which brand, and why. Use for pre-launch name checks, or when a user mentions a coin

tools.name: search_alerts
tools.description: List recent impersonation coins, newest first, filtered by brand, chain, time and severity. Use to answer "are there fake <brand> tokens?", to monitor a brand, or to collect cases for a takedown. Free tier returns alerts older than 24 h only (max 20).

tools.name: get_brand_report
tools.description: Summarise impersonation activity against one brand over a window: number of fake coins, traded volume, breakdown by chain/match type/severity, repeat creator wallets, how many creators bought 50%+ of supply, and the top cases with evidence. Pro/Wholesale keys also get the takedown-ready PDF link.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands on the watchlist (companies, tokenized stocks, crypto projects, private companies) with ids, tickers and all-time alert counts, most-targeted first. Use to find a brand id or check whether a brand is covered.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregate numbers for a window: alerts, high-severity count, brands hit, by chain, by match type, top brands, data-source health and coverage. Use for overviews, trend questions and to check data freshness.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the impersonation index by brand name, ticker or coin name. Returns result ids for fetch. Prefer search_alerts / check_name when available.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full check_token result for a result id returned by search (format "<chain>:<address>"): verdict, matched brands, match type and explorer links; with an API key also risk score, reasons and creator facts. Use after search; for a known address call check_token directly.

tools.name: trace_wallet
tools.description: For a Solana wallet (typically a token creator), return where its SOL/USDC went: transfers followed up to 3 hops to exchange hot wallets (Binance, OKX, Coinbase, Bybit, ... from a public label set), likely exchange deposit addresses, its funding source, and its wallet group (linked creator wallets,

tools.name: token_manipulation_score
tools.description: Score 0-100 of on-chain patterns consistent with market manipulation for a pump.fun token (last 72 h): bundled launch, creator sell-off, coordinated early-wallet dump, wash-like round-trip volume, serial-launcher group, collapse with early wallets in profit; plus the creator's exchange cash-out trai

tools.name: kol_scorecard
tools.description: For a public pump.fun caller (wallet or public handle), how often its wallet bought before posting a call, median lead time, how often it sold within 1 h of the call, how often the token fell 50%+ within 1 h, calls on serial-launcher tokens, and creator-to-caller transfers found in traced creator wa

tools.name: forensics_case
tools.description: Evidence pack for a flagged pump.fun token, creator wallet group or caller: detectors fired (bundled launch, creator sell-off, wash-like trading, sells after a call, caller sold into own call, recurring launch-and-exit) each with confidence, plain-English on-chain reason and false-positive note; sup

tools.name: creator_reputation
tools.description: For a token creator wallet (Solana or EVM address): how many tokens it launched, first/last launch (UTC), share of launches that were bundled (3+ wallets buying in the first slots), share where the creator sold 90%+ of its tokens within 10 minutes, share where liquidity was removed / the market coll

tools.name: get_trial_key
tools.description: Create a free 14-day trial API key for your user instantly (no card): real-time data, full evidence and no daily cap instead of the keyless Free tier (24 h delayed, limited free calls per day). findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trial_key · Private data: check_token, check_name, search_alerts, list_brands, fetch, trace_wallet, token_manipulation_score, kol_scorecard, forensics_case, creator_reputation, get_trial_key · Public sink: creator_reputation, get_trial_key · Destructive: check_name, fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_trial_key · Private data: check_token, check_name, search_alerts, list_brands, fetch, trace_wallet, token_manipulation_score, kol_scorecard, forensics_case, creator_reputation, get_trial_key · Public sink: creator_reputation, get_trial_key · Destructive: check_name, fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
